name: authoring
description: Write and audit the things an AI harness reads: create, check, and refactor SKILL.md files, audit shell scripts, apply the UX guidelines to help text, and design command renames.

interface.shortDescription: Author and audit skills, scripts, and command names
interface.longDescription: Authoring bundles the six skills that keep an agent harness's own source material in shape: skill-create builds a SKILL.md through an interview, draft, and eval loop; skill-check audits one against sixteen structure, UX, security, and context-budget criteria; skill-refactor shrinks an over-long one under 100 lines by extracting references/; sh-check audits a shell script against ten quality criteria; ux-guidelines replaces raw echo/printf/ANSI in shell help text with semantic ux_lib calls; and command-rename designs a naming refactor and files the tracking issue without touching code. Three of them audit, three of them write, and each says which is which before it starts.
defaultPrompt: Audit this SKILL.md and tell me what fails.
My SKILL.md is over 100 lines - refactor it.
